```{r}

transcripts |> 
  mutate(
    count_Chen = str_count(transcript, "(?<!MRS\\.\\s)(?<!Mrs\\.\\s)CHEN"),
    .keep = "unused",
    .after = title
  ) |> 
  arrange(count_Chen) |> 
  select(1:6)

transcripts |> 
  mutate(count_Chen = str_count(transcript, "(?<!MRS\\.\\s)(?<!Mrs\\.\\s)CHEN"), .keep = "unused") |> 
  mutate(ep_ID = as_factor(ep_ID) |> fct_reorder(count_Chen) |> fct_rev()) |>
  ggplot(aes(ep_ID, count_Chen)) +
  geom_col() + 
  theme_light() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5))

```

```{r}

transcripts |> 
  mutate(
    murder = str_count(transcript, "(M|m)urder[(s|ed)]?\\s"),
    stabbing = str_count(transcript, "(S|s)tab[s|bing|bed]?\\s") +
      str_count(transcript, "(K|k)nifed"),
    assault = str_count(transcript, "(A|a)ssault[ed]?\\s"),
    suicide = str_count(transcript, "(S|s)uicid(e|al)"),
    .after = title
  )

transcripts |> 
  mutate(
    murder = str_count(transcript, "(M|m)urder[(s|ed)]?\\s"),
    stabbing = str_count(transcript, "(S|s)tab[s|bing|bed]?\\s") +
      str_count(transcript, "(K|k)nifed"),
    assault = str_count(transcript, "(A|a)ssault[ed]?\\s"),
    suicide = str_count(transcript, "(S|s)uicid(e|al)"),
    .after = title
  ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = ep_ID)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = murder), color = "black") +
  geom_point(aes(y = stabbing), color = "red") +
  geom_point(aes(y = assault), color = "blue") +
  geom_point(aes(y = suicide), color = "darkgreen") +
  labs(x = "Episode", y = "Number of Mentions")

```

```{r}

transcripts |> 
  mutate(
    count_Chen = str_count(transcript, "(?<!MRS\\.\\s)(?<!Mrs\\.\\s)CHEN"),
    .keep = "unused",
    .after = title
  ) |> 
  select(1:6) |> 
  group_by(season) |>

```

```{r}

transcripts |> 
  filter(episode_number == 1) |> 
  mutate(
    transcript = str_remove_all(transcript, "\\s*[-–]?\\s*\\[[^]]+\\]\\s*[-–]?\\s*\n*") |>
      str_remove_all("\\s*[-–]?\\s*\\([^)]+\\)\\s*[-–]?\\s*\n*") |>
      str_replace_all("\n{3,}", "\n\n") |> 
      str_split("\n\n")
  ) |> 
  unnest(transcript) |> 
  mutate(
    transcript = str_remove(transcript, "^[\\s\\-–]*"),
    rowID = row_number(),
    type = case_when(
      str_detect(transcript, "(INT|EXT)\\.") ~ 
      "scene_heading",
      str_detect(transcript, "[A-Z]+[:punct:]*[A-Z]+$") ~ "caption",
      str_detect(
        transcript,
        "^[A-Z][A-Z]+(?:[,/]\\s*[A-Z]+|\\sand\\s[A-Z]+)+(?=[A-Z\\d]{1}[a-z\\d\'\\s-]+)"
      ) ~ "dialogue_multi_speaker",
      str_detect(
        transcript, "^[A-Z][A-Z\\s]+(?=[A-Z]{1}[a-z\\d\'\\s-]+)"
      ) ~ "dialogue"
    ),
    speaker = if_else(
      type == "dialogue" | type == "dialogue_multi_speaker",
      str_extract(
        transcript,
        "^[A-Z][A-Z\\s,/]+(?:\\sand\\s[A-Z]+)*(?=[A-Z\\d]{1}[a-z\\d\'\\s-]+)"
      ),
      NA_character_
    ),
    transcript = if_else(
      type == "dialogue" | type == "dialogue_multi_speaker",
      str_remove(
        transcript,
        "^[A-Z][A-Z\\s,/]+(?:\\sand\\s[A-Z]+)*(?=[A-Z\\d]{1}[a-z\\d\'\\s-]+)"
      ),
      transcript
    ),
    scene = case_when(
      type == "scene_heading" & str_detect(transcript, "EXT\\.") ~ "EXT",
      type == "scene_heading" & str_detect(transcript, "INT\\.") ~ "INT"
    )
  ) |> 
  separate_longer_delim(speaker, delim = regex("(,\\s|\\sand\\s|/)")) |> 
  select(type, speaker, scene, transcript)
```

```{r}
transcripts |> 
  filter(episode_number == 6) |> 
  mutate(
    transcript = str_remove_all(transcript, "\\s*[-–]?\\s*\\[[^]]+\\]\\s*[-–]?\\s*\n*") |>
      str_remove_all("\\s*[-–]?\\s*\\([^)]+\\)\\s*[-–]?\\s*\n*") |>
      str_replace_all("\n{3,}", "\n\n") |> 
      str_split("\n\n")
  ) |> 
  unnest(transcript) |> 
  mutate(
    transcript = str_remove(transcript, "^[\\s\\-–]*"),
    rowID = row_number(),
    type = case_when(
      str_detect(transcript, "(INT|EXT)\\.") ~ 
      "scene_heading",
      str_detect(transcript, "[A-Z]+[:punct:]*[A-Z]+$") ~ "caption",
      str_detect(
        transcript,
        "^[A-Z][A-Z]+(?:[,/]\\s*[A-Z]+|\\sand\\s[A-Z]+)+(?=\"|[A-Z\\d]{1}[a-z\\d\'\\s-]+)"
      ) ~ "dialogue_multi_speaker",
      str_detect(
        transcript, "^[A-Z][A-Z\\s]+(?=\"|[A-Z\\d]{1}[a-z\\d\'\\s-]+)"
      ) ~ "dialogue",
      TRUE ~ "other"
    ),
    speaker = if_else(
      type == "dialogue" | type == "dialogue_multi_speaker",
      str_extract(
        transcript,
        "^[A-Z][A-Z\\s,/\\.]+(?:\\sand\\s[A-Z]+)*(?=\"|[A-Z\\d\"]{1}[a-z\\d\'\\s-]+)"
      ),
      NA_character_
    ),
    transcript = if_else(
      type == "dialogue" | type == "dialogue_multi_speaker",
      str_remove(
        transcript,
        "^[A-Z][A-Z\\s,/\\.]+(?:\\sand\\s[A-Z\"]+)*(?=\"|[A-Z\\d\"]{1}[a-z\\d\'\\s-]+)"
      ),
      transcript
    ),
    scene = case_when(
      type == "scene_heading" & str_detect(transcript, "EXT\\.") ~ "EXT",
      type == "scene_heading" & str_detect(transcript, "INT\\.") ~ "INT"
    )
  ) |> 
  separate_longer_delim(speaker, delim = regex("(,\\s|\\sand\\s|/)")) |> 
  select(type, speaker, scene, transcript)
```
